name: india-gst
description: Use this skill whenever asked to prepare, review, classify or advise on India's Goods and Services Tax (GST) for FY 2026-27, for a self-employed individual, freelancer or small business with one GSTIN. Trigger on phrases like GST return, GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-9, GSTR-2B, file GST, GST classification, HSN code, SAC code, input tax credit, ITC, reverse charge, IGST, CGST, SGST, GST registration threshold, QRMP, e-way bill, LUT export, GST late fee, GST rates after 22 September 2025, 5% 18% 40% GST, or any question about GST compliance in India. It covers the 56th GST Council rate structure in force from 22 September 2025, CGST and SGST or IGST, domestic and import reverse charge, e-invoicing scope, ITC conditions and blocked credits, return due dates and late fees, exports and SEZ, e-way bills, registration thresholds, QRMP, a supplier pattern library and bank statement reading guide. Tier 2, not reviewed by an accountant.
